description: This header file defines interfaces and class declarations related to a Data Model client for a device management system, including notifier interface, client interface, and related classes.

classes.name: dmProviderProxy
classes.description: A placeholder class for the provider proxy, currently without methods or members.

classes.name: dmClientNotifier
classes.description: Interface for handling query results and errors, with virtual methods for callbacks.

classes.name: dmClient
classes.description: Abstract class defining the data model client, including a factory method for creation and destruction.

methods.name: dmClient::runQuery
methods.description: Pure virtual method to run a data model query with specified parameters.

methods.name: dmClient::create
methods.description: Static factory method to instantiate a dmClient with a specified data model directory and log level.

methods.name: dmClient::destroy
methods.description: Static method to destroy a dmClient instance.
